name: Ax
overview: The Bible presents the ax primarily as a practical tool used for cutting wood, as seen in Deuteronomy 19:5 where a man goes into the woods to hew wood with an ax. Its importance in daily life is further highlighted in 1 Samuel 13:20-21, where sharpening axes alongside other farming implements was necessary for the Israelites. The narrative in 2 Kings 6:5-6 demonstrates God's power over nature when Elisha causes an iron ax head to float on water, underscoring divine intervention in ordinary circumstances. Additionally, Psalm 74:5 uses the ax figuratively to represent strength and fame through labor, showing that the ax also carries symbolic meaning beyond its physical use.
